sqlTemplate:
SELECT 'BF',
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.client_id)
FROM (SELECT client_id
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
      WHERE baseline_regimen_start_date >= :startDate AND baseline_regimen_start_date < :endDate) a
         LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM person p WHERE p.dead = 1 AND p.death_date <= :endDate) p
                   ON a.client_id = p.person_id
         LEFT JOIN mamba_fact_transfer_in mfti ON a.client_id = mfti.client_id
         INNER JOIN (SELECT client_id
                     FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card
                     WHERE pregnant = 'Breast feeding'
                       AND encounter_date >= :startDate AND encounter_date < :endDate
                     UNION
                     SELECT client_id
                     FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_summary
                     WHERE baseline_lactating = 'YES'
                       AND encounter_datetime >= :startDate AND encounter_datetime < :endDate) breast_feeding
                    ON breast_feeding.client_id = a.client_id
WHERE p.person_id IS NULL
  AND mfti.client_id IS NULL;
